Description: The Klamath River Renewal Corporation, or KRRC, is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization formed by signatories of the amended Klamath Hydroelectric Settlement Agreement, or KHSA. The KHSA was amended in April 2016 and calls on the KRRC to assume ownership of the Klamath River’s four lower hydroelectric dams in order to decommission them.
